title: rumex acetosa var. pratensis
intro: Rumex acetosa var. pratensis, commonly known as Field Sorrel, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Polygonaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include lowering inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high levels of vitamin C, potassium, and other antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Field Sorrel include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Field Sorrel include flavonoids, carotenoids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
